item.description: A total solar eclipse has reached Iceland. In Reykjavík, the moon started passing in front of the sun at 4:47 p.m. local time (12:47 p.m. ET), then totality began at 5:48 p.m. (1:48 p.m. ET) and lasted for about one minute.
